content.title: Apply waitForResponse fix to sibling parent-selector test
content.description:
While validating the flake fix for the 'changes an existing parent' test in phase3-validation.spec.ts around line 1287, I found that its sibling test 'sets a parent via search and selection' around line 1235 still uses the OLD flaky pattern. The search-response wait is registered AFTER the input fill that triggers the request, which is exactly the race condition the developer just fixed in 'changes an existing parent'. A fast search response can resolve before the listener registers and the wait hangs for a stale or debounced response.

Scope: apply the same fix to 'sets a parent via search and selection'. Register the response wait BEFORE the fill, and scope the matcher to the exact search term via URLSearchParams, matching the pattern now used in 'changes an existing parent'. Also worth auditing other tests in the file that wait on search responses for the same anti-pattern.

Note: I could not confirm whether this sibling test is currently manifesting as a flake because it is presently failing deterministically due to uncommitted frontend WIP that makes the issues list render as empty. The anti-pattern is a real code-quality issue regardless. Filed by webapp-validator while working issue mqe1uwxa5q.

content.content: Triage: not a duplicate (related flake work mqe1drwrck/mqe1uwxw8c is closed; this is a new extension found during that validation). Purely technical/internal idea routed to webapp team technical owner (webapp-developer) for decision. Filed by a worker, not a manager, so not auto-accepted. Review task: mqgwmy76fo. Decision gate: mqgwn6zwiu (blocked by review). Idea set in-progress to keep it out of the work loop until the decision lands.

Accepted per webapp-developer review (mqgwmy76fo). Retagged idea -> chore. Implementation plan (frontend, completes at Validate):
- Plan (mqgzjnns95, webapp-developer): confirm fix approach from review.
- Dev (mqgzjuwgpw, webapp-developer): in phase3-validation.spec.ts 'sets a parent via search and selection' (~line 1235), move the waitForResponse promise ABOVE the searchInput.fill, and scope the matcher to method GET + issues endpoint + new URL(resp.url).searchParams.get('search') === 'Set Parent Target'. Blocked by Plan.
- Validate (mqgzjyv8j4, webapp-validator): re-run the e2e suite serially to confirm the sibling test no longer flakes and no regressions. Blocked by Dev.
No release task (webapp completes at Validate). Review's file audit confirmed no other search-response anti-patterns exist.
Status loop: all phase children (review, plan, apply, validate) are done. Top-level chore fully delivered — closing and clearing descendants.
